clips.title: The story
paras: Along Mist's Edge in northern Darkshore, Gelkak Gyromast is stranded after threshadons sank his ship. The gnome talks like a pirate captain and wants his mechanical first mate, the Threshwackonator 4100, working again.

West of the Ruins of Mathystra, Gelkak Gyromast is stranded on Darkshore's northern coast. The gnome talks like an old sea dog and calls himself captain. Threshadons sank his ship just offshore, and he washed up on the misty shore. The key to his mechanical first mate, the Threshwackonator 4100, broke on the rocks. Crawlers, foreststriders and murlocs rummaging through the wreckage carried off its pieces.
